checks.check: S1.1 native ArrayBufferView::byteLength() keeps the inverted test
checks.detail: ArrayBufferView.h:83 (byteOffset) and :105 (byteLength); 2 occurrences of the inverted form

checks.check: S1.2 the inverted test is spelled '!(' , i.e. a valid view returns 0 and an OOB view returns raw
S1.3 JSArrayBufferView::byteLength()/length() are NOT inverted -- they use integerIndexedObject*
checks.detail: JSArrayBufferView.h:238 length(), :311 byteLength() -- the JS-level view never calls the native test

checks.check: S1.4 isOutOfBounds() is the spec test (isArrayBufferViewOutOfBounds), not the native one
S2.1 JSArrayBufferView::toWrapped refuses every resizable/growable-shared view
S2.2 JSArrayBufferView::toWrappedAllowShared refuses them too ([AllowShared] is not a bypass)
S2.3 JSGenericTypedArrayView::toWrapped / toWrappedAllowShared refuse them as well
S2.4 Converter<IDLArrayBufferView> goes through toWrapped (Disallow) and [AllowShared] through toWrappedAllowShared -- so every IDL ArrayBufferView parameter is gated
S2.5 possiblySharedImpl() has 4 call sites and only IDBKey is outside a gate
S2.6 IDBKey::createBinary only READS the native view (copyData); no write sink in its body
S2.7 the serializer's raw producer is preceded by the isOutOfBounds() test
S3.1 every IDL ArrayBufferView consumer is classified (no 'unclassified' rows)
S3.2 the write-consumer set is exactly the 5 known operations
S3.3 WebGL is the write consumer that needs a build flag, and the flag is OFF on this port
S3.4 WebCodecs is OFF by default in this drop (so copyTo does not exist)
S4.1 set/fill/copyWithin/sort all call validateTypedArray() on the receiver first
checks.detail: validateTypedArray(globalObject, thisObject) x12 in the prototype functions

checks.check: S4.2 validateTypedArray throws on isIntegerIndexedObjectOutOfBounds
S4.3 the index write path (view[i]=v) checks inBounds(), which reads the LIVE buffer length
S4.4 DataView.set* uses viewByteLength() and throws RangeError instead of writing
S5.1 every .cpp function with a native ArrayBufferView&/* parameter was found
S5.2 the only native ArrayBufferView&/* write consumer in the tree is Crypto::getRandomValues
checks.detail: writers=[('Crypto.cpp', 57)] (WebGL's readPixels/getBufferSubData hand the view to the driver, not to ArrayBufferView::set*)

checks.check: S5.3 the typed-view spelling of the same shape is TextEncoder::encodeInto: Ref<Uint8Array>&&, bound = array->byteLength(), write = U8_APPEND into array->baseAddress()
S5.4 neither is reachable with a resizable view: the gate is the binding converter (S2.4), not anything inside the function
checks.detail: no gate inside either body -- the refusal happens before the call
